verdict.rationale: mParticle documents several public HTTP API surfaces: the Events API with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, a Platform API (Audiences), a Profile API, the Warehouse Sync API, and the versioned Data Subject Request API v3. Together these let a programmatic or agent consumer drive ingestion, audiences, warehouse sync and privacy requests. missing for 10: machine-readable specs for the Platform and Profile APIs (only the Events API has one), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the Open API (previously known as Swagger) specification or similar tools to generate helper SDKs (using Swagger Codegen or OpenAPI Generator) for the Events API: Events API Open API Spec.
The spec file itself downloads as OpenAPI 3.0.3 YAML
Update to the v3 base URL https://opendsr.mparticle.com/v3
